data.narrative:
DEFCON AI is a Seed-stage defense and security AI company founded by Yisroel Brumer, Paul Selva, and Grant Verstandig. The company has raised $44M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 private companies and 2 public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) in the defense and security sector, with notable private peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods triangulate to a defensible range. Stage-Progression applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $44M raised proxy, implying $110M—a floor reflecting typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up economics. Peer-Median compares DEFCON AI to five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comps (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed; Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI spanning Series A at $125M–$4.0B), yielding a median of $1.0B across the peer band of $125M–$4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $94M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $555M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether DEFCON AI's market positioning, traction, and defensibility align with higher-valued Series A peers or lower-end Seed comparables. Key sensitivities include revenue traction, competitive differentiation versus the Shield AI and Helsing cohort, and customer concentration risk in defense procurement.
